title: The Storm Peaks
body: The Storm Peaks rise in the northeast of Northrend, a realm of wind-scoured summits and glaciers, and the highest mountain is crowned by the open-sided Temple of Storms. This was the domain of the titans' keepers. At its northern edge stands Ulduar, a titan city now held by Loken, whose iron dwarves make war on every creature of stone. The old pacts lie broken: the frost giants of Dun Niffelem feud with the Hyldnir, the vrykul women who serve the brooding Thorim, and goblins, frost dwarves and Brann Bronzebeard chase the secrets of the peaks.

title: Brunnhildar Village
body: Brunnhildar Village is the stronghold of the Hyldnir, frost vrykul women who call themselves the servants of Thorim. Here the women rule and fight, and they hold that whoever wins the Hyldsmeet, their sacred contest of strength, is assured a lifetime at Thorim's side. They war with the frost giants of Dun Niffelem and meet any outsider with steel; their captives dig in the Forlorn Mine.

parts.body: Their sisters at Valkyrion took the Lich King's offer when Brunnhildar dismembered his emissaries, and those who receive his gift fly as val'kyr.
sources: npc_text 13540 (the Hyldsmeet is sacred; victory assures a lifetime next to Thorim)

parts.body: Lok'lira, a crone freed from the mine, wants Thorim roused to retake Ulduar. The champion of the Hyldsmeet won the Drakkensryd around his temple, and Thorim looked up from his grief and spoke a name: Sif.

title: Thorim
body: Thorim, the Stormlord, is a being of near godlike stature who served the titans as guardian of Ulduar and the Terrace of the Makers. Now he sits alone in the Temple of Storms on the summit of the highest mountain in Northrend, sunk in a grief so deep that he barely heeds those who climb to him, while the Hyldnir compete for the honor of a lifetime at his side. What broke him he does not tell to strangers.

parts.body: His grief is for his wife Sif, slain by his own brother, who tricked him into blaming her death on Arngrim, king of the frost giants. He turned on his allies, and when he saw what he had done, gave in to despair.
sources: npc_text 13778 (near godlike stature; guardian of Ulduar and the Terrace of the Makers)

parts.body: He called his brother out near the Temple of Wisdom and had the better of him, until Loken turned the fight with treachery and his minions carried the Stormlord off.

title: Frosthold
body: Frosthold lies in a great pit of ice atop a mountain in the southwest of the peaks, the stronghold of the frostborn, the frost dwarves, a warrior people whose stormcrest eagles are their allies and mounts. They are ruled by King Yorg Stormheart, held to be the wisest and strongest leader they have known, whose peachy skin sets him apart from those he rules. An Explorers' League expedition has made camp among them.

parts.body: Years ago the frostborn found a mountain dwarf wandering in bloodied snow with no memory of his name, who grew to stone and lightning to slay a jormungar. They named him Yorg, a name kept for champions of legend.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Frosthold (pit of ice atop a mountain, southwestern Storm Peaks, home of the frostborn)

parts.body: Brann Bronzebeard knew the king at once: Yorg Stormheart is his brother Muradin, long thought dead. Remembering Arthas, Muradin set out alone to make him answer for what he has done.

title: Dun Niffelem
body: Dun Niffelem is the city of the frost giants who call themselves the Sons of Hodir, where spikes of ice rise over their halls. They are at war with the Hyldnir, whose captured warriors stand frozen in ice for the giants to mock. Once allies of Thorim, they have long nursed a hatred of the Stormlord. Northeast of the city lies Thunderfall, a desolate field of frozen fossils bound up with a dark memory the giants have never let go.

parts.body: The giants will never forgive Thorim until something takes the place of what Thunderfall keeps alive, their king says: a memorial built from the shattered pieces of Hodir's Horn.
sources: quest 12856 description (Dun Niffelem east of the valley; captive proto-drakes; sisters frozen in ice and taunted)

parts.body: Thorim came and begged forgiveness, and King Jokkum granted it, returning Krolmir, the Hammer of Storms, on which his father Arngrim cast a rune with his final act.

title: Bouldercrag's Refuge
body: Bouldercrag's Refuge is an old titan building on a mountain face where the earthen expelled from Ulduar have taken shelter under Bouldercrag the Rockshaper, who remembers when his people's hammers hewed stone instead of iron. On the Snowdrift Plains below they hold the line against Loken's stormforged, and across the plains the iron dwarves hold Nidavelir and dig the Frozen Mine with captive mechagnomes.

parts.body: The plates bolted to the stormforged golems are saronite alloyed with iron, from deep in Azeroth's crust and made by a malevolent force: armor for something colossal.
sources: quests 12885, 12929 descriptions (old titan building, west of the Inventor's Library)

parts.body: The iron colossus fell on the Snowdrift Plains to a tamed jormungar's acid, but only defeating Loken inside Ulduar will make the day last, Bouldercrag says.

title: The Engine of the Makers
body: In the midst of the Foot Steppes, east of Frosthold, a great pit of titan works is sunk deep into the ground, and beside it stands a lonely watcher, Creteus, whom the frostborn call the keeper. He favors visitors who use their tongues before their blades. On the northern coast south of Ulduar stands the Inventor's Library of Keeper Mimir, its guardians still murmuring through their protocols in his long absence.

parts.body: Creteus's databank found the other watchers gone from the temples of the Terrace of the Makers, and he fears their absence spells dark times for all of Azeroth.
sources: quest 12865 description (Foot Steppes east, hard land, rhino, proto-drakes)

parts.body: When an iron host came for Norgannon's Core, Creteus understood: someone is using the Forge of Wills to make an army, and Ulduar is no longer safe.

title: The Terrace of the Makers
body: The Terrace of the Makers spreads over the high ground northwest of Dun Niffelem toward Ulduar, the sacred grounds of the titans. Temples crown its heights, the Temple of Invention of Keeper Mimir, the Temples of Winter, Life and Order, the Hall of the Shaper and the Temple of Wisdom, and it is a battlefield: iron dwarves burst from the ground while the earthen, sworn to guard these grounds with their lives, fight on.

parts.body: Loken's most powerful lieutenants held the terrace for him, and one by one they fell to Thorim's champion and the earthen.

title: Ulduar
body: Ulduar rises at the northern edge of the Storm Peaks, a titan city of colossal halls, towers and gates, and Loken holds it now. Its earthen makers live in exile, and from its outer works open the Halls of Stone and the Halls of Lightning. On the approach a trader and a flight master keep their camps for travelers.

parts.body: Brann Bronzebeard has led an expedition to the gates, where the Explorers' League and K3 have rebuilt siege engines and the Kirin Tor shield their platform. What waits within is for those who follow to learn.

title: Loken
body: Loken is the master of Ulduar, a keeper of the titans who has taken the city for himself. When he seized it he expelled the earthen who had built and tended it, and he sent his favorite servants, the iron dwarves, on a brutal campaign against all the creatures of stone. Wherever the stormforged march across the peaks, they march in his name.

parts.body: Lok'lira, the frail prisoner who set Thorim's awakening in motion, was Loken's illusion: he waited in that mine for a champion bold enough to rouse his brother and draw him close to the power of Loken's own master.

title: Brann Bronzebeard
body: Brann Bronzebeard, the famed explorer of the Explorers' League and a brother of King Magni of Ironforge, has come to the Storm Peaks on the trail of Ulduar, and no one quite knows where he is: the secrets of the titans have drawn him north across Northrend, and his notes point to these mountains.

parts.body: The titans' creations are at war, he warns, Loken has taken Ulduar, and if Horde and Alliance spend themselves on each other, Loken will destroy them both.
sources: quest 12854 description (Brann's camp across the Bor's Breath River at the foot of ruins of the Path of the Titans)

parts.body: Shell and core were joined at last with Brann there to see it: Norgannon's keystone, the key to Ulduar's archives.
